title: Kettle Lane Cycles — bicycle servicing and repairs
description: A two-bench bicycle workshop. Book a service online, drop the bike off on the way to work, and collect it the same evening.

sections.title: In by nine, riding home by six.
sections.lede: Drop your bike off on the way to work and collect it the same evening, serviced, cleaned and with a note of everything we did.

media.alt: A road bike on a workshop stand, its rear wheel off and tools laid out on the bench

items.name: Safety check
items.body: Brakes, gears, tyres and bolts checked and adjusted. Twenty minutes, while you wait.

items.name: Full service
items.body: Everything in the check, plus wheels trued, drivetrain cleaned and cables replaced where worn.

items.name: Rebuild
items.body: Stripped to the frame, every bearing serviced, built back up. Allow three days.

sections.title: Book a service
sections.body: Choose the service and a drop-off time. We confirm by email within the hour.

services.name: Rebuild
services.body: We call when it is ready.

sections.title: From the people who ride in

items.text: Dropped it off at 8:15, picked it up at 5:30 with a list of what they did and what can wait until spring.
They told me the expensive part did not need replacing yet. That is why I keep coming back.
The only workshop that explains the problem on the bike, with the bike, before charging for it.

sections.title: Find us
sections.body: Two benches, one street apart. Both take bookings and walk-ins.

items.name: Kettle Lane
items.note: Bike parking for drop-offs at the door.

items.q: Do you work on electric bikes?
items.a: Yes, on the bike itself: brakes, gears, wheels and tyres. Motors and batteries go back to their maker, and we can send them for you.

items.q: What if it needs more than the service?
items.a: We stop and call you with a price before we do anything that costs more than £15.
Yes, at no charge, indoors and insured. Most rebuilds stay with us for three nights.
A few second-hand ones we have rebuilt ourselves, each with a year's free safety checks.

sections.title: Not sure what it needs?
sections.body: Send a photo and a sentence about the noise it makes. We will tell you which service, or whether it needs one at all.

footer.note: Kettle Lane Cycles is an independent workshop. Prices include VAT and parts up to £10.
